scenes: Why do the lights go out in a heatwave?
Heat pushes demand up, as everyone switches on cooling. | If supply falls at the same time, the lines cross, | and the power goes out.
In northern Viet Nam in 2023, heat met low hydropower reservoirs. | Blackouts cost about one point four billion dollars.
Shave the peak: cooler buildings, smarter demand.
